name: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side: 3rd Story
original_name: ときめきメモリアル Girl's Side 3rd Story
source:
The game takes place at Habataki High School seven years after Tokimeki Girl's Side 1. There are a total of six new bachelors plus three secret characters. 
TMGS 3 implements a totally new system; the Love Triangle. Instead of rival girls liking your man, all six bachelors are paired with another, making it so that you can 'date' two of them at a time. TMGS 3 also introduces a revamped clothing system with a few new clothing styles and the ability to 'level up' your fashion.

[From [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在《心跳回忆Girl's Side》第一作七年后的羽崎学园。可攻略对象包括六名全新单身男性及三名隐藏角色。
《TMGS 3》采用了全新的"三角恋"系统。与过去由情敌女孩喜欢上你的心上人不同，六名男性会两两配对，让你能够同时与其中两人"约会"。本作还重新设计了服装系统，增加若干新风格，并允许玩家为时尚等级进行"升级"。

[摘自[url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]
